baseline.method: $SDK/bin/bl --cold run probe.bl ((println 1)) from a scratch dir under work run, 5 runs
baseline.note: first run is a cold page cache; median of runs 2-5 is 2,777 ms
baseline.stage_probe: scripts/sealed-boot/phases.exs (start_app! cut at its own stage boundaries)

profile_before.method: deep-stack sampler (/tmp probe deepstacks.erl: running + file/code-server-blocked processes, backtrace depth 80), 2 cold runs, 1,367 samples

changes: AOT/sealed_seed_table_at: a /nix/store table is read and decoded once per VM (no sha256 per miss); other paths keep the digest check

AOTCache/immutable_toolchain + immutable_memo: packaged_compiler? and the live compiler/build keys are computed once per VM when priv/ and the codegen roots are all under /nix/store (packaged floor proof never memoized)
Env/live_toolchain_keys: no per-call stamp (wildcard + ~250 stats) on an immutable toolchain

AOT native declarations: negative answers primed and cached under a separate .none name; the bootstrap scan's answer (declaring sources) primed as native-declarations/<key>/declaring.term and used on an immutable root instead of the wildcard and stat walk

AOT/prime_image_metadata! (selfbuild do-prime): priv/image-metadata.term, one deterministic decode per sdk-code.term row (2,567 rows, 6.5 MB, 4.9 s to prime); Env/sdk_image_metadata_at! and sdk_image_metadata! take the sealed row on an immutable root when the entry's :sha256 and the sha256 of the whole caller row match
AOT/sdk_preinit_floor_ready?: a TRUE proof is remembered under its post-proof inputs (it ran twice per cold start)

scratch_image_method.why: the sealed artifact needs an SDK build, which this lane must not run
scratch_image_method.how: scripts/sealed-boot/build-image copies the store image (reflink), overlays the edited host beams compiled by scripts/check-runtime-hosts (restamped with the shipped source digest, so the compiler key and every unit stay valid), runs the producer's sealing functions in a second VM, and adds the result to /nix/store with nix store add-path; scripts/sealed-boot/measure runs alternating paired cold starts through the SDK's own boot.exs path (boot-at.exs) with bl-cold's environment

images.C: scratch copy, unchanged hosts, resealed with the shipped code (control)

scratch_image_method.equality: seal.exs decodes every one of the 2,567 rows live and compares: equal=2567 differ=0

measured.summary: cold bl run 2,962 -> 2,163 ms median (-27%) against the unchanged SDK, 2,860 -> 2,163 ms (-24%) against the resealed control; the :beam_lisp app start 1,944 -> 1,326 ms. The card's 1.2 s target is not reached.

profile_after.method: same sampler on B (3 runs 2,482-2,554 ms under the sampler), 964 samples over 2 runs

gate: build the SDK from this branch, then scripts/sealed-boot/measure $OLD_SDK 4 OLD=<old image root> NEW=<new image root> (or $SDK/bin/bl --cold run in alternation); expect the new image to carry priv/image-metadata.term (2,5xx rows) and native-declarations/<key>/declaring.term and *.none files; test/bl/image_metadata_table_test.bl on the built SDK exercises the sealed path (built? true)
